Full layouts and numeric values for admin headers, status, legacy payloads, and notify tables beyond observed field use.
Admin queue creation, destruction, completion signaling, timeout handling, and qualifier meanings beyond submission and status mapping.

findings.text: Platform driver lifecycle registers during init and unregisters during exit, with exit additionally releasing command line devices. Probe and remove behavior is attached through the driver instance.
The MMIO transport uses a fixed name for matching and binds device tree and ACPI tables, attaching power operations only when sleep support is configured.
A predicate reports legacy admin availability for a PCI function. It requires a discoverable parent device plus admin queue negotiation plus full coverage of a legacy command bitmap.
Virtual function paths first resolve parent driver data and treat lookup failure as absence by propagating a null device upward.
The PCI transport structure embeds the generic device structure, and a helper recovers the enclosing transport object from the embedded member address.
Two public write entry points cover common configuration and device configuration by selecting different legacy opcodes and sharing one internal writer.
Two public read entry points cover device configuration and common configuration by selecting different legacy opcodes and sharing one internal reader.

Legacy writes validate the parent and function identity, allocate a combined header and payload buffer, record offset and payload content, and submit through the modern admin executor with grouped member addressing offset by one.

Legacy reads validate the parent and function identity, prepare a request carrying the offset, expose caller memory for the result, and submit through the modern admin executor with matching grouped addressing.

A notify query submits a legacy information command then scans a bounded result table for the first entry matching requested flags, stopping at an end marker and reporting missing when no entry matches, otherwise returning bar identity and offset.

Admin execution gates on negotiated admin support, allocates distinct header and status storage, chains header with optional data for output and status with optional result for input, submits the chains, then maps non success device status into a negative error while always releasing allocations.

Submission verifies a bound queue, authorizes the opcode, arms completion state, retries queue full insertions with relaxation until progress or breakage, holds protection across insertion and kick, then waits for completion and returns the stored result.
Two list related opcodes bypass capability checks while all other opcodes require their bit in a supported mask, otherwise submission fails as unsupported.
Admin queue insertion and kick execute under the admin queue lock with interrupt state saved, and the lock is released before waiting for completion.
A queue index identifies the admin queue only when admin support is negotiated and the index equals the stored admin position.
A static transport selection flag defaults to disabled.
Queue notification stores the queue selector into the mapped notification location reachable through per queue private storage and always reports success.

Interrupt handling samples a status register once, ignores the interrupt when clear, forwards configuration indications to a dedicated path, walks normal queues, and claims handling whenever any source was active.
Configuration handling notifies the upper layer then dispatches slow path queues, while normal dispatch walks regular queues and remembers whether any queue claimed work.
Traversal and mutation of regular and slow queue lists occur under the device lock with interrupt state saved, covering both interrupt dispatch and queue setup.

Vector provisioning reserves name and mask storage, optionally enables affinity with an extra configuration pre vector, allocates vectors, requests the configuration handler first, validates assigned configuration routing, then optionally requests one shared handler for all queues.
A single distinguished vector value denotes the slow path and queue setup uses that test to choose list membership.

Generic queue setup allocates tracking storage, delegates creation to transport logic, links the tracker into regular or slow lists when a callback exists, otherwise leaves it isolated, and frees storage when creation fails.

Legacy creation rejects missing or already active queues, records routing, creates a ring with legacy alignment, rejects descriptor addresses beyond thirty two bits, programs the page frame and notification location and vector, and unwinds address and ring on failure.
Legacy queue registers follow select then access discipline across size and enable and address and vector fields, with vector updates flushed by a read back.

Modern creation chooses notification style from negotiated features, exempts the admin queue from count bounds, applies availability checks, creates a ring with cache line alignment, activates the queue, maps per queue notification, and destroys the ring on activation or mapping failure.
Activation programs ring size and three queue area addresses, then programs vector routing unless disabled, treating refusal as busy.

Modern common configuration selects a queue before touching size and enable and vector and address fields, writes sixty four bit addresses as low half then high half, and flushes vector updates by reading back.
The advertised queue count comes from a direct read of a count field without prior selection.
Notification mapping rejects scaled offsets whose required width exceeds the mapped length with a warning and null result, otherwise returns a direct offset or a mapped window.
Legacy creation fails when descriptor memory resides above the addressable range, reporting a platform limitation and aborting with a too big error.
Queue full handling retries with relaxation until success or breakage, so a persistently full queue can delay the submitter indefinitely.
Reading the interrupt status also clears pending indications, so the sampled value must be preserved for sharing between configuration and queue paths.
A synchronization helper waits for the legacy handler and for every allocated message signaled handler to complete.
